pattern: Text rating plus a native list of requirements with state in text; a polite live region for debounced summaries. The segmented bar is aria-hidden (the text carries the meaning).

keyboard.action: Not focusable; it follows the input the user types in.

focus: Not focusable. Reference describedById from the input so the rating and checklist are read with the field.
notes: Each requirement reads "At least 12 characters, met" / "..., not met" (visually hidden state), never icon or color alone.
After typing pauses for 1 s, one polite summary is announced when it changed: "Password strength: Good. 4 of 4 requirements met."
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
